contract_findings: validate_gather_payload requires exactly table minus IndexedAxis. Keeping P%16 requires Payload=[P%16,Record], 512B; Payload=[Record] mismatches the declared table.
validate_gather_output constructs payload.pair(domain), then sequences that full stream against the output. The public contract has no zipped/diagonal shared-axis selector.

CPU BufStorage::gather factors table into payload x indexed_axis and output into payload x domain, loops every payload row over every domain index, and rejects any destination slot written twice. Merely repeating the named P%16 axis in payload and fullP domain cannot authorize selecting one replica pertoken.

Mapping::pair constructs a Pair except identity simplification; size is left.size*right.size. The exact sequencing/normalization implementation is prebuilt; no specific compiler error or runtime behavior has been measured here.

Dropping P%16 from domain to avoid overlap would require one shared dynamic mantissa per16 tokens and would violate independently varying per-token maxima. Materializing all16 replicas with a separate axis increases logical record payload16x and needs an explicit later selection.
decision: SOURCE_CONTRACT_NO_GO for retained replica axis with full token/group index domain; no implementation or compilation performed

explicit_supported_alternative.cost_obligation: The replica coordinate must be explicitly encoded into each index. A separate immutable per-row base owner adds a real input/load; any alternative generation must use supported APIs. No fabricated device/SPM address or free retained-axis selection.
explicit_supported_alternative.scope: Public declaration/relative-offset contract only. Allocation, actual lowerer, bandwidth distribution, startup cost and runtime gain are not validated.

next_gate: Wait for complete grouped-FFN measured phase breakdown before deciding whether a separately preregistered replica-index repair is worthwhile. No replica build authorized.

observed_fixture_correlation.cause: Not established. Actual run emitted no NPU_SPAN records; complete-FFN phase data is still needed.

requested_form.wanted: One32B record at replica=p%16 and mantissa=index for each token/group; no explicit replica base in index
